_comment: Verified against a real running OpenClaw 2026.7.1-2 instance (openclaw config get), not just docs. Don't hand-edit API keys into this file — use openclaw models auth login --provider <id> or openclaw configure so credentials go through OpenClaw's own secret handling, not a checked-in file.

list.name: fieldops
list._comment: Model config is per-agent, not global — this is what keeps the personal 'main' agent's model settings untouched. `openclaw models set/fallbacks` don't support --agent; this has to be set via openclaw config patch against agents.list, as done here.
